acceptance: Crate aipo-lexer implemented according to crate contract.
Complete token classification: keywords, identifiers (Unicode NFC), numbers (_ separators, bases), strings (regular, f, r, fr, multiline), operators, delimiters, newlines, comments.
Lexical diagnostics emitted without panic (unterminated string, invalid escapes, unexpected characters).
Pass exhaustive unit tests and token snapshot fixtures.
CI quality gates green (fmt, check, clippy, doc, test).
constraints: No numeric evaluation in lexer: classification only.

evidence.description: cargo test -p aipo-lexer: 5 tests passed covering keywords, numbers, string prefixes, and lexical diagnostics

non_goals: Syntactic parsing or AST construction (reserved for S3).
objective: Implement aipo-lexer with full token classification, Unicode NFC, string prefixes, and snapshots
title: Lexer Core: Tokens, string prefixes, and lexical diagnostics
